info.name: Sospesi nel tempo
info.plot: Lo scacciafantasmi Frank Bannister si serve di tre amici spettri per inscenare finti poltergeist e spillare soldi alle vittime: ma quando si trova davanti a un serial killer fantasma, dovrà cambiare tattica e trasferirsi nell'aldilà.

translations.tagline: Non c'è pace per i dannati

translations.overview: Once an architect, Frank Bannister now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent.
